parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description:
The database type. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **Oracle**

To specify multiple types, separate them with a comma.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the available regions.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description:
The share type. Valid values:

- **ShareIncoming**: backups shared with you.

- **ShareOutgoing**: backups you shared.
